_note: Series (#1847, the bridge's B11; decision 84): dated videos, read by core/series/. `countdown` - one idea a day from `from` to the day before `until` in the channel's timezone, the topic `title` with {n} the days left, facts the day's headlines naming one of `names` (else the date alone), each Short placed in `playlist` in day order (#1855); SERIES_COUNTDOWN=false stops it. `moment` - a Short drafted on its `on` date as an extra draft; `needs` words must be in that week's subject headlines or it is skipped with the reason; `on: null` waits for a date (set it when Rockstar states it); `publish_at` (ISO UTC) is when it goes public, null = the next free slot (#1870). `long` - a 10-12 minute 16:9 video drafted on its `on` date, rendered only after your review (#1850); its title carries the first YouTube suggestion for subject + one of its `search_terms` (#1856). `slots` - extra public hours for a video naming the subject inside `from`-`to`, and a story on 5+ outlets naming it is drafted first then (#1868, #1867). `style` - the colours a long video's card uses (#1869). SERIES_DATED=false stops the moments and long videos.
